description: Add tests for the pipeline system: test stage validation, status tracking, CLI argument parsing, LLM fallback, and end-to-end dry run. Verify everything passes ruff and pytest.
steps: Create tests/ directory at project root
Create tests/conftest.py with fixtures: tmp video folder, sample topic.yaml, sample research.yaml, sample script.md, etc.
Create tests/test_produce.py: test CLI arg parsing (--help, --from, --only, positional topic), test stage ordering, test dry run mode
Create tests/test_stages.py: test that each stage validates its input correctly (fails gracefully when previous output missing), test status.yaml updates
Create tests/test_llm.py: test the fallback/placeholder mode generates valid structured output, test the generate() function interface
Run pytest tests/ -v and ensure all tests pass
Run ruff check . and ruff format --check . and ensure all pass
acceptance_criteria: tests/ directory exists with test files
Tests cover: CLI parsing, stage validation, status tracking, LLM fallback
